query.paging: Currentsearchv1.1 offset/limit; default100,max500; legacyv1search retired2026-10-01 per docs.
query.identity: One museum origin; native objectID is identity, accessionNumber/title are not unique. Preserve metadataDate and response SHA-256 for mutable record snapshots; artwork date is not metadata version.
query.subset_scope: OA-image-bearing native object metadata. Keyword/title search is sampled, not a guarantee of complete topical relevance or image availability.

negative_observations.invalid_limit: limit=-1 unexpectedly returns HTTP200 with100 IDs; clients must bound/validate limit instead of relying on API rejection

licensing: Selected collection metadata CC0, including records for copyrighted objects. OA-designated/public-domain images CC0 separately; other materials remain restricted. Trademark, third-party and endorsement exceptions retained.
limitations: 15 passing native IDs all came from one title-filtered Buddha sample; ten earlier Monet objects failed the OA-image subset predicate and remain recorded.
Keyword Shiva matched an artist named Shiva Ahmadi; no semantic relevance guarantee. Repeated titles must retain distinct native IDs.
The provider hasImages filter returned objects with empty primaryImage/isPublicDomain=false; check each object and do not infer rights from object age.
One anonymous item page and one361x624 web JPEG verified; the original image exceeded2MiB and remains unverified as a complete file. No rendered desktop/mobile or India/USA network certification.
Negative limit returned200; locally validate bounds. No later-day reliability or refresh/deletion rehearsal for this catalog.
The legacy v1 search endpoint is retired per current docs; object details remain v1. No bulk image collection, production import or activation.
next_action: Complete rendered desktop/mobile reader and keyboard checks for representative allowed items, broaden title/artist ambiguity tests without overriding per-object OA flags, and rehearse metadata/rights-change refresh handling. Obtain later-day reliability evidence on a subsequent run. Keep source and area qualification open.

identity_and_duplicates.summary: The Metropolitan Museum of Art operates one collection origin. Current object IDs distinguish15 identically titled Buddha records. Accession numbers and titles are not identity; metadataDate and response hashes preserve mutable versions, while objectDate describes the artwork.

facts.creator: Unknown/empty artist field retained without invention

coverage_and_languages.summary: Declared research subset is English museum-artwork metadata with positive public-domain flag and image URL, C16. Fifteen title-filtered examples include cultural attributions to India, Sri Lanka, Cambodia/Vietnam, Thailand, China and Korea. This is collection geography, not proof of network availability, multilingual coverage or area completion.

query_contract.summary: Current published v1.1 search supports offset/limit and title/artist filters; old v1/search is retired. Object detail remains v1/objects/{objectID}. Fifteen exact native-ID examples pass; saved two-page search has no overlap, nonsense yields empty/null IDs, invalid limit is silently tolerated, and missing-object response is saved. Enforce local bounds and per-object OA flags.

facts.auth: Anonymous; no API key/registration required by current docs

rights_and_cost.summary: Selected collection metadata is CC0 including records for copyrighted artworks. Only OA-designated images are CC0; restricted materials and trademarks keep separate terms. Fifteen retained examples have positive public-domain flags; representative38160 page also says Public Domain. No API fee/key; published cap80requests/second, research serial>=3seconds.

facts.content_rights: Per-object OA flag and published OA designation, never inferred from metadata access

reader_access.summary: Anonymous object38160 page returns200 with matching title/culture/public-domain statement. Provider web JPEG decodes361x624 and visual inspection matches a standing sculpture. Original image returned200 but exceeded2MiB cap; no complete-original claim or bulk download.
open_questions: Rendered desktop/mobile keyboard/accessibility and representative language/country reading checks; full-resolution access remains bounded/unverified.

quality_and_relevance.summary: Native IDs remain distinct despite equal titles. Title=Buddha sample passes15 records. Generic Shiva matched an artist; hasImages did not enforce public-domain images. Preserve10 failed Monet subset checks and all negative/paging responses.
open_questions: Broaden independently chosen title/artist/culture ambiguity and filtered recall samples before claiming general topic quality.

operating_limits.summary: All requests serial and paced with robots checks; no auth, paid account or access bypass. One original image cap stopped unbounded content capture; the explicitly published web representation was checked separately.
